summary: The superheterodyne receiver stage by stage: noise, front end, oscillators, mixers and images, IF filters, detectors, squelch, audio processing and interference.

blocks.title: The superheterodyne
items: A superheterodyne shifts every station to one fixed IF, intermediate frequency, for sharp filters and strong gain.

items.def: the receiver's own internal noise. It limits sensitivity.
ratio of the largest tolerable input to the minimum discernible signal.
noise generated in the front end and succeeding stages. The RF stage mainly sets it.
a strong signal on a nearby frequency reduces sensitivity.
strong signals mix into false signals.
a very strong station's modulation is heard on top of yours.
mainly improves noise figure. Just enough gain for weak signals to overcome first mixer noise; too much invites intermodulation from nearby transmitters.
high gain, low noise floor. Low noise amplifiers belong in the VHF front end RF stage.

blocks.title: Oscillators
items: Oscillating takes sufficient positive feedback.
3 majors: Colpitts (capacitive divider), Hartley (tapped coil), Pierce (crystal).
VFO, variable frequency oscillator: commonly Colpitts, because it's stable.
VCO, voltage-controlled oscillator: a frequency synthesizer's oscillator stage.

blocks.title: Mixers
items: A mixer combines 2 signals: out come the originals plus their sum and difference.
Overdriven, a mixer makes spurious mixer products.

blocks.title: IF stages
items: IF bandwidth: slightly wider than the signal. Too wide lets undesired signals reach the audio stage.
First IF stage: selectivity. Final IF stage: gain.
Choosing an IF: weigh image rejection and selectivity.
SAW, surface acoustic wave: an IF filter for micro-miniature circuits.

blocks.title: Detectors
head: Detector
For
How
rows: Mixes with a locally generated carrier

blocks.title: Squelch and audio
items: Detection: recovery of intelligence from the modulated RF signal.
Squelch works on the presence of noise, CTCSS on tones (about 67 to 254 Hz), Digital Coded Squelch on digital codes.
The CTCSS tone is filtered out after the discriminator, before the audio section.
De-emphasis with transmitter pre-emphasis: flat audio and noise reduction.
DSP, digital signal processing: samples analog signals, processes numbers, converts back. Noise subtraction: adaptive filtering and autocorrelation.
Op-amp audio filter: select bandpass characteristics.

blocks.title: Keeping it clean
items: Low-pass filters: AVC (AGC) circuit and power supply, not the oscillator.
Ignition noise: ferrite beads in the primary and secondary ignition leads.
Popping with engine speed: resistances in series with spark plug wires.

blocks.title: Exam traps
items: Extra RF or IF gain adds no selectivity.
Image of 162.000 MHz? That's the IF added to the channel.
Colpitts, Hartley and Pierce are oscillators, not filters.
